requirements.title: ErrClosed is non-nil
requirements.text: ErrClosed shall be a non-nil error value (RELAY spec §5.1 mandatory sentinel).

requirements.title: ErrNotConnected is non-nil
requirements.text: ErrNotConnected shall be a non-nil error value (RELAY spec §5.1 mandatory sentinel).

requirements.title: ErrTimeout is non-nil
requirements.text: ErrTimeout shall be a non-nil error value (RELAY spec §5.1 mandatory sentinel).

requirements.title: ErrPayloadTooLarge is non-nil
requirements.text: ErrPayloadTooLarge shall be a non-nil error value (RELAY spec §5.1 mandatory sentinel).

requirements.title: ErrNotFound is non-nil
requirements.text: ErrNotFound shall be a non-nil error value, returned by ParseEndpointID/RequestFromMessage when a relay.Message.ID does not resolve to a valid avtp.ByteBusID (RELAY spec §5.4-style protocol-specific sentinel).

requirements.title: Mandatory sentinels are mutually distinct
requirements.text: The four mandatory RELAY sentinels (ErrClosed, ErrNotConnected, ErrTimeout, ErrPayloadTooLarge) shall be pairwise distinct: errors.Is shall not match one against another.

requirements.title: ErrClosed wraps relay.ErrClosed
requirements.text: ErrClosed shall wrap relay.ErrClosed such that errors.Is(rcp.ErrClosed, relay.ErrClosed) returns true.

requirements.title: ErrNotConnected wraps relay.ErrNotConnected
requirements.text: ErrNotConnected shall wrap relay.ErrNotConnected such that errors.Is(rcp.ErrNotConnected, relay.ErrNotConnected) returns true.

requirements.title: ErrTimeout wraps relay.ErrTimeout
requirements.text: ErrTimeout shall wrap relay.ErrTimeout such that errors.Is(rcp.ErrTimeout, relay.ErrTimeout) returns true.

requirements.title: ErrPayloadTooLarge wraps relay.ErrPayloadTooLarge
requirements.text: ErrPayloadTooLarge shall wrap relay.ErrPayloadTooLarge such that errors.Is(rcp.ErrPayloadTooLarge, relay.ErrPayloadTooLarge) returns true.

requirements.title: ErrNotFound wraps ErrNotConnected
requirements.text: ErrNotFound shall wrap ErrNotConnected (and therefore, transitively, relay.ErrNotConnected) such that errors.Is(rcp.ErrNotFound, rcp.ErrNotConnected) and errors.Is(rcp.ErrNotFound, relay.ErrNotConnected) both return true.

requirements.title: Command latency bounded under GC pressure
requirements.text: The go-RCP mock controller shall deliver commands via Send with a maximum observed latency less than half the watchdog period (5 ms at 100 Hz) when measured under sustained 64 MiB/s GC allocation pressure. Evidence shall be recorded in safety/COMMAND_LATENCY.md.

requirements.title: Each endpoint's token bucket refills at Config.Rate tokens per second
requirements.text: ratelimit.Controller shall refill the token bucket for a given avtp.ByteBusID at Config.Rate tokens per second. After N seconds with no requests to that endpoint, its bucket shall contain min(N*Rate, Burst) additional tokens. Buckets for different endpoints are tracked independently.

requirements.title: Bucket token count is capped at Config.Burst
requirements.text: ratelimit.Controller shall cap each endpoint's token bucket at Config.Burst. Accumulated tokens from refill shall never exceed Burst regardless of elapsed time.

requirements.title: Request returns ErrBusy immediately when the addressed bucket is exhausted
requirements.text: ratelimit.Controller.Request shall return an error wrapping ratelimit.ErrBusy immediately (without blocking) when the target endpoint's token bucket contains fewer than one token. No request shall be forwarded to the inner controller on an ErrBusy return.

requirements.title: Cancellation-kind requests bypass the bucket when ExemptCancellation is true
requirements.text: When Config.ExemptCancellation is true, ratelimit.Controller shall forward a request whose request.Kind.IsCancellation() is true to the inner controller without consuming a token and without returning ErrBusy. When ExemptCancellation is false, cancellation-kind requests are subject to the same bucket check as all other kinds.

requirements.title: StreamID() delegates to the inner controller
requirements.text: ratelimit.Controller.StreamID() shall return the inner controller's own avtp.StreamID identity.

requirements.title: Close() is idempotent and subsequent Requests return ErrClosed
requirements.text: ratelimit.Controller.Close() shall be safe to call multiple times and shall return nil on all calls. After Close(), Request shall return an error wrapping udp.ErrClosed without forwarding to the inner controller.

requirements.title: Controller is safe for concurrent use
requirements.text: ratelimit.Controller shall be safe for concurrent use by multiple goroutines each calling Request simultaneously, without data races or incorrect per-endpoint token accounting.

requirements.title: Each bucket starts full; DefaultConfig returns ASIL-B recommended values
requirements.text: A newly created endpoint bucket shall start with tokens equal to Config.Burst (bucket full). DefaultConfig() shall return a Config with positive Rate, positive Burst, and ExemptCancellation=true.

requirements.title: Allow entry permits exact principal/stream/endpoint triple
requirements.text: authz.Policy.Evaluate shall return true for a (principal, requester avtp.StreamID, target avtp.ByteBusID) triple that matches an Allow entry before any Deny entry in the ordered list.

requirements.title: Unmatched requests are denied by default
requirements.text: If no policy entry matches the (principal, stream, endpoint) triple, authz.Policy.Evaluate shall return false (default deny). An explicit Deny entry evaluated before a later Allow shall also return false.

requirements.title: Wildcard fields match any value in that dimension
requirements.text: An empty Principal shall match any caller. authz.StreamAny (the IEEE 802 broadcast address, never a legitimate unicast sender StreamID) shall match any requester stream. authz.EndpointAny (0xFF) shall match any avtp.ByteBusID. Wildcards enable broad permit/deny entries without enumerating every value.

requirements.title: Per-call principal override via context
requirements.text: authz.WithPrincipal shall embed a principal string in the context. authz.Controller.Request shall prefer the context principal over the static principal supplied at construction.

requirements.title: Policy entries may be replaced atomically
requirements.text: authz.Policy.SetEntries shall replace all entries in a single critical section so that concurrent Evaluate calls see either the old set or the new set, never a partial mix.

requirements.title: Policy evaluation is safe under concurrent access
requirements.text: authz.Policy shall use a readers-writer lock so that concurrent Evaluate calls do not race with concurrent Allow/Deny/SetEntries calls.

requirements.title: StreamID and Discover delegate to the inner controller without a policy check
requirements.text: authz.Controller.StreamID and authz.Controller.Discover shall delegate directly to the wrapped *udp.Controller without applying policy checks, mirroring regmap.AccessController's own deliberate universal, grant-independent discovery exception server-side.

requirements.title: Close is idempotent; Request after Close returns ErrClosed
requirements.text: Calling authz.Controller.Close more than once shall be safe and return nil. Any Request call after the first Close shall return udp.ErrClosed without forwarding to the inner controller.

requirements.title: Broadcast delivers the request to all group members concurrently
requirements.text: zonegroup.Group.Broadcast shall send the same (avtp.ByteBusID, acf.ControlFlags, body) request to every member *udp.Controller concurrently and wait for all responses before returning, achieving atomic multi-target delivery within the context deadline.

requirements.title: Each result records the responding member's own StreamID
requirements.text: Broadcast shall record each member's own avtp.StreamID identity in that member's MemberResult, so a broadcast to several members is distinguishable per member regardless of the addr common to all of them.

requirements.title: BroadcastResult.OK is false if any member fails
requirements.text: BroadcastResult.OK shall return false if any member returns a non-nil transport error or a response with acf.FlagError set. All results are collected regardless of individual failures.

requirements.title: Context cancellation propagates to all member Requests
requirements.text: If the context passed to Broadcast is cancelled or times out, that same context is forwarded to each member Request call so all in-flight requests are cancelled simultaneously.

requirements.title: StreamIDs and Len report the group membership
requirements.text: Group.StreamIDs shall return the avtp.StreamID of each member in insertion order. Group.Len shall return the number of members.

requirements.title: NewGroup rejects empty or nil-member lists
requirements.text: NewGroup shall return an error if the member slice is empty or contains a nil controller, preventing construction of an invalid group.

requirements.title: Close is idempotent; Broadcast after Close returns ErrClosed
requirements.text: Group.Close shall close every member controller exactly once and be safe to call multiple times. Any Broadcast call after the first Close shall return udp.ErrClosed.

requirements.title: Concurrent Broadcasts are race-free
requirements.text: Multiple goroutines may call Broadcast simultaneously on the same Group without data races. The Group's member list is immutable after construction.

requirements.title: Handler forwards requests to the upstream endpoint transparently
requirements.text: proxy.Handler.HandleRequest shall forward the request to the upstream *udp.Controller and return the upstream response unchanged when no TransformFunc is set.

requirements.title: TransformFunc may remap the byte_bus_id and rewrite the body before forwarding
requirements.text: If a TransformFunc is set, proxy.Handler.HandleRequest shall call it with the original downstream requester, addr, control flags, and body before forwarding. The returned (addr, body), which may differ from the input, is sent to the upstream controller — the byte_bus_id-remapping half of a real RCP-level proxy.

requirements.title: TransformFunc error aborts the forward without reaching upstream
requirements.text: If TransformFunc returns a non-nil error, HandleRequest shall return that error immediately and not forward the request to the upstream controller.

requirements.title: Handler presents its own upstream StreamID identity, never the downstream requester's
requirements.text: proxy.Handler shall forward every request through its own upstream *udp.Controller, which frames the AVTPDU with that Controller's own avtp.StreamID — the original downstream requester's StreamID is never itself put on the wire upstream, the stream_id-remapping half of a real RCP-level proxy.

requirements.title: The response is repackaged to correlate with the original downstream request
requirements.text: HandleRequest shall return a response whose Kind, ByteBusID, and TransactionNum match the original downstream request's own values, regardless of what addr was actually used upstream, so the upstream remapping is invisible to the downstream caller.

requirements.title: Close is idempotent; HandleRequest after Close returns ErrClosed
requirements.text: Calling proxy.Handler.Close more than once is safe and returns nil. Any HandleRequest call after the first Close shall return proxy.ErrClosed without attempting to reach the upstream controller.

requirements.title: Concurrent HandleRequest calls are race-free
requirements.text: Multiple goroutines may call HandleRequest simultaneously on the same proxy.Handler. The Handler's closed flag is accessed via atomic operations.

requirements.title: Handler is composable as an ordinary request.Handler
requirements.text: proxy.Handler implements request.Handler, so it may be registered into a udp.Router the same as any native endpoint's own Handler, including being registered into more than one Router instance, enabling a further hop to be chained in front of it.

requirements.title: Requests go to the primary controller when it is healthy
requirements.text: redundancy.Controller.Request shall forward requests to the primary *udp.Controller and return its response when the primary returns no error.

requirements.title: Primary failure triggers failover to standby
requirements.text: When the primary controller returns a qualifying error, redundancy.Controller shall swap primary and standby atomically, increment the failover counter, and return the primary error to the caller. The next Request uses the former standby as the new primary.

requirements.title: Active returns the currently active controller
requirements.text: redundancy.Controller.Active shall return the *udp.Controller that will be used for the next Request, reflecting any completed failovers.

requirements.title: FailoverPolicy may suppress failover
requirements.text: If a FailoverPolicy is provided and returns false for a given error, the controllers shall not be swapped and the error is returned without incrementing the failover counter.

requirements.title: StreamID delegates to the active controller
requirements.text: redundancy.Controller.StreamID shall delegate to whichever controller is currently primary, reflecting the post-failover state.

requirements.title: Close is idempotent; Request after Close returns ErrClosed
requirements.text: Close shall close both primary and standby controllers and be safe to call multiple times. Any Request after the first Close shall return udp.ErrClosed.

requirements.title: Concurrent Requests are race-free during failover
requirements.text: Multiple goroutines may call Request simultaneously. The primary/standby swap is guarded by a mutex so that at most one goroutine triggers the swap and all subsequent Requests see the new primary.

requirements.title: Failovers counter reports the total number of primary swaps
requirements.text: redundancy.Controller.Failovers shall return the cumulative number of times the active controller has been swapped, remaining exactly one per qualifying failure even under concurrent callers, enabling callers to detect repeated failovers.

requirements.title: Register claims exclusive server ownership for an HPC
requirements.text: federation.Registry.Register shall associate a caller-chosen server key with ctrl and return nil. If no other controller owns the key, the registration succeeds.

requirements.title: Lookup returns the owning controller for a registered server key
requirements.text: federation.Registry.Lookup shall return the *udp.Controller registered for a key. If no controller owns the key, it shall return ErrNotOwned.

requirements.title: Registering an already-owned key returns ErrAlreadyOwned
requirements.text: If a key is already registered to any controller, a subsequent Register call shall return ErrAlreadyOwned without modifying ownership.

requirements.title: Release removes key ownership; releasing an unowned key returns ErrNotOwned
requirements.text: federation.Registry.Release shall remove the key from the registry. If the key has no owner, Release shall return ErrNotOwned.

requirements.title: Keys and Owner report the current registry state
requirements.text: Keys shall return the set of all registered server keys. Owner shall return the controller for a given key, or nil if unowned.

requirements.title: TransferOwnership atomically reassigns a server between HPCs
requirements.text: TransferOwnership shall atomically replace the owner of a key from the from controller to the to controller. If from does not own the key, it shall return ErrNotOwned.

requirements.title: All Registry operations are race-free under concurrent access
requirements.text: Register, Release, Lookup, Owner, Keys, and TransferOwnership shall use a readers-writer lock ensuring no data race under concurrent read and write operations.

requirements.title: Multiple HPCs may own disjoint server subsets in the same Registry
requirements.text: A federation.Registry shall support any number of HPC-controller pairs each owning a disjoint set of server keys. Cross-HPC Lookup succeeds transparently.

requirements.title: GET /servers lists all registered servers
requirements.text: The admin server shall return a JSON array of ServerInfo for every server key Registered on GET /servers.

requirements.title: GET /servers/{key} returns server detail
requirements.text: The admin server shall return a JSON ServerInfo for a known server key on GET /servers/{key}, and 404 for an unregistered key.

requirements.title: POST /servers/{key}/request dispatches a request
requirements.text: The admin server shall parse the JSON body (endpoint, write, body), dispatch it via the registered *udp.Controller for key, and return the JSON-encoded acf.Message response on POST /servers/{key}/request. It shall return 404 for an unregistered key and 400 for an unparsable body.

requirements.title: Bearer auth on the request endpoint
requirements.text: When BearerToken is configured, POST /servers/{key}/request shall return 401 if the Authorization header does not match.

requirements.title: GET /events SSE stream
requirements.text: The admin server shall stream per-server health events as Server-Sent Events on GET /events, one event per Flush boundary, and shall reject a non-GET method with 405.

requirements.title: GET /metrics Prometheus format
requirements.text: The admin server shall emit per-server health, request count, error count, and deadline miss count in Prometheus text format on GET /metrics.

requirements.title: RecordRequest updates telemetry
requirements.text: The admin server shall update per-server health, last-seen timestamp, request count, error count, and deadline miss count when RecordRequest is called, on both the first (create) and subsequent (existing-entry) calls for a given key.

requirements.title: Register rejects a duplicate key; concurrent access is race-free
requirements.text: Server.Register shall return udp.ErrAlreadyExists for a key that is already registered. The admin server shall be safe for concurrent RecordRequest and HTTP handler invocations without data races.

requirements.title: Load parses a YAML server config file
requirements.text: The config package shall parse a v1 YAML server configuration file — one ServerEntry per declared server, including its stream_id and declared endpoint topology — and return a validated File struct.

requirements.title: Load parses a JSON server config file
requirements.text: The config package shall parse a v1 JSON server configuration file and return a validated File struct.

requirements.title: Decode detects format from extension
requirements.text: Decode shall use .yaml/.yml for YAML and .json for JSON; other extensions shall return an error.

requirements.title: ErrInvalidVersion on unsupported version
requirements.text: Load shall return a wrapped ErrInvalidVersion when the version field is not 1.

requirements.title: ErrDuplicateServer on a repeated server key
requirements.text: Load shall return a wrapped ErrDuplicateServer when the same server key appears more than once in the servers list, and a wrapped ErrDuplicateAddress when the same endpoint address appears more than once within one server's declared endpoints. It shall also return a wrapped ErrInvalidStreamID when a server's stream_id is not 16 hex characters.

requirements.title: Watch calls onChange on initial load
requirements.text: Watch shall call onChange synchronously with the parsed config before returning.

requirements.title: Watcher.Reload hot-reloads config
requirements.text: Watcher.Reload shall re-parse the config file and call onChange with the new config.

requirements.title: Watcher.Stop terminates background goroutine
requirements.text: Watcher.Stop shall terminate the background goroutine without leak.

requirements.title: Schema registration
requirements.text: Registry.Register shall store a Schema by name and return ErrAlreadyRegistered if a schema with that name already exists.

requirements.title: Schema lookup miss
requirements.text: Registry.Lookup shall return ErrSchemaNotFound when no schema with the requested name is registered.

requirements.title: Schema retrieval
requirements.text: Registry.Lookup shall return the Schema previously stored by Register for the same name.

requirements.title: Payload encoding
requirements.text: Encode shall serialise a Payload to JSON bytes when all field values match the declared FieldKind and no unknown fields are present.

requirements.title: Payload decoding
requirements.text: Decode shall deserialise JSON bytes into a Payload map whose keys and values correspond to the original encoded data.

requirements.title: Field type enforcement
requirements.text: Encode shall return ErrFieldTypeMismatch when a Payload value's Go type is incompatible with the Field's declared FieldKind.

requirements.title: Unknown field rejection
requirements.text: Encode shall return ErrUnknownField when the Payload contains a key not declared in the Schema.

requirements.title: Typed send delegation
requirements.text: TypedController.SendTyped shall encode the Payload using the named registered Schema and delegate to the inner *udp.Controller.Request with the encoded bytes as the request body, addressed at the caller-supplied avtp.ByteBusID and acf.ControlFlags.

requirements.title: Controller connects to a registered Server
requirements.text: grpcbridge.RegisterServer shall register the Bridge gRPC service on a grpc.Server, and grpcbridge.NewController shall successfully dial it.

requirements.title: Controller.Request round-trips through the upstream endpoint
requirements.text: grpcbridge.Controller.Request (via Write) shall transmit a request over gRPC to a Server wrapping an upstream *udp.Controller, and return the real endpoint's echoed response body.

requirements.title: Unregistered-endpoint responses surface as FlagError
requirements.text: grpcbridge.Controller.Read against an endpoint with no registered upstream handler shall return a response whose Control carries acf.FlagError, forwarded from the upstream's own wire-level error response, not a transport-level error.

requirements.title: Server.Request forwards the request payload unmodified
requirements.text: grpcbridge.Server.Request shall forward RequestMsg.Body to the upstream *udp.Controller unmodified and return the endpoint's response body unchanged in ResponseMsg.Body.

requirements.title: Server.PublishTelemetry reaches Controller.Subscribe
requirements.text: grpcbridge.Server.PublishTelemetry shall deliver a TelemetryEvent to every connected Controller.Subscribe stream.

requirements.title: Idempotent close
requirements.text: grpcbridge.Controller.Close shall be idempotent; repeated calls after the first shall return nil without error.

requirements.title: Closed request error
requirements.text: grpcbridge.Controller.Request (and Read/Write) shall return ErrClosed after Controller.Close has been called.

requirements.title: Server.Request error propagation
requirements.text: grpcbridge.Server.Request shall propagate an error from the upstream *udp.Controller (e.g. a request whose context has already expired) as a gRPC-level error to the calling Controller.

requirements.title: HTTP request endpoint delivers to the upstream controller
requirements.text: restbridge.Server shall expose POST /v1/endpoints/{addr}/request to forward a JSON-encoded request to the upstream *udp.Controller addressed to the given avtp.ByteBusID.

requirements.title: JSON response includes the control field
requirements.text: restbridge.Server shall return a JSON ResponseBody including byte_bus_id, transaction_num, control, and body fields, allowing a caller to distinguish a normal response from a wire-level error via the control field's FlagError bit.

requirements.title: Invalid endpoint address rejection
requirements.text: restbridge.Server shall return HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity when the {addr} path parameter does not parse as a valid avtp.ByteBusID (0-255).

requirements.title: SSE telemetry endpoint
requirements.text: restbridge.Server shall expose GET /v1/telemetry as a Server-Sent Events stream delivering TelemetryEvents published via Server.PublishTelemetry.

requirements.title: Controller.Write round-trips through the upstream endpoint
requirements.text: restbridge.Controller.Write shall POST the request body to the server and decode the JSON ResponseBody into an acf.Message whose Body matches the real upstream endpoint's echoed response.

requirements.title: Unregistered-endpoint responses surface as FlagError
requirements.text: restbridge.Controller.Read against an endpoint with no registered upstream handler shall return a response whose Control carries acf.FlagError, forwarded from the upstream's own wire-level error response, not an HTTP-level error.

requirements.title: Idempotent close
requirements.text: restbridge.Controller.Close shall be idempotent; repeated calls after the first shall return nil without error.

requirements.title: Closed request error
requirements.text: restbridge.Controller.Request (and Read/Write) shall return ErrClosed without making a network request after Controller.Close has been called.

requirements.title: SOME/IP header/payload round-trip over the wire path
requirements.text: someip's Server/Controller pair shall round-trip a SOME/IP REQUEST/RESPONSE datagram end to end, with the RESPONSE payload matching the payload the upstream endpoint echoed.

requirements.title: Server ignores a REQUEST for a different ServiceID
requirements.text: someip.Server shall not respond to a REQUEST datagram whose ServiceID does not match the Server's configured serviceID.

requirements.title: Server forwards a REQUEST to the upstream controller
requirements.text: someip.Server shall forward a REQUEST datagram's payload to the upstream *udp.Controller as one plain request addressed to the avtp.ByteBusID the MethodID's low byte names.

requirements.title: Server responds NOT_OK for an unregistered endpoint
requirements.text: someip.Server shall reply with a RESPONSE datagram whose ReturnCode is NOT_OK when the upstream controller's response carries acf.FlagError (e.g. an unregistered endpoint).

requirements.title: Controller.Read selects a read request via an empty payload
requirements.text: someip.Controller.Read shall send a REQUEST with an empty payload, which someip.Server forwards upstream as a read request (acf.FlagRead).

requirements.title: Controller.Write selects a write request via a non-empty payload
requirements.text: someip.Controller.Write shall send a REQUEST whose payload is forwarded upstream as a write request (acf.FlagWrite) with that exact payload as the body.

requirements.title: Idempotent close
requirements.text: someip.Controller.Close shall be idempotent; repeated calls after the first shall return nil without error.

requirements.title: Closed request error
requirements.text: someip.Controller.Request (and Read/Write) shall return ErrClosed without sending a datagram after Controller.Close has been called.

requirements.title: Controller.Send validates and encodes a Frame
requirements.text: canbr.Controller.Send shall reject an invalid can.Frame (per can.Frame.Validate) before forwarding it, and otherwise encode it via can.EncodeFrame and forward it as a write request to the wrapped can.Endpoint.

requirements.title: Controller.Receive decodes the response frame
requirements.text: canbr.Controller.Receive shall issue a read request to the wrapped can.Endpoint and decode the response body via can.DecodeFrame into the returned can.Frame.

requirements.title: Send rejects an invalid frame without a wire round trip
requirements.text: canbr.Controller.Send shall return an error without forwarding any request when the given can.Frame fails can.Frame.Validate.

requirements.title: Wire-level error responses are reported as ErrNotAResponse
requirements.text: canbr's decodeResponse shall return ErrNotAResponse when a response carries acf.FlagError (e.g. an unregistered endpoint), rather than attempting to decode its body as a can.Frame.

requirements.title: Undecodable response bodies are reported as ErrNotAResponse
requirements.text: canbr's decodeResponse shall return ErrNotAResponse when a response body does not parse as a valid can.Frame via can.DecodeFrame.

requirements.title: StreamID delegates to the wrapped Controller
requirements.text: canbr.Controller.StreamID shall return the wrapped *udp.Controller's own avtp.StreamID identity.

requirements.title: Idempotent close
requirements.text: canbr.Controller.Close shall delegate to the wrapped *udp.Controller's Close and be idempotent; repeated calls after the first shall return nil without error.

requirements.title: End-to-end round trip through a real CAN endpoint
requirements.text: canbr.Controller.Send followed by canbr.Controller.Receive shall round-trip through a genuinely registered can.Endpoint reached via a udp.Router, not a stub, exercising Send's write path and Receive's independent read path against the endpoint's own received-frame state.

requirements.title: Domain topic registration
requirements.text: ddsbr.Domain.NewTopic shall create and register a named Topic; subsequent NewTopic calls with the same name shall return the existing Topic.

requirements.title: DataWriter broadcast delivery
requirements.text: ddsbr.Topic.Write shall deliver the sample to all subscribed DataReaders without blocking the caller.

requirements.title: DataReader sample receipt
requirements.text: ddsbr.DataReader.Read shall yield a channel that receives samples written to the topic after the DataReader was created.

requirements.title: Bridge.PublishResponse fans out endpoint responses
requirements.text: ddsbr.Bridge.PublishResponse shall publish a caller-supplied acf.Message response as a ResponseSample to the telemetry DataWriter's topic.

requirements.title: Bridge.PublishTrigger fans out trigger-event counts
requirements.text: ddsbr.Bridge.PublishTrigger shall publish a caller-supplied trigger-event count for an avtp.ByteBusID source as a TriggerSample to the telemetry DataWriter's topic.

requirements.title: Bridge command dispatch
requirements.text: ddsbr.Bridge shall read CommandSample values from cmdReader and forward each as a plain request to the upstream *udp.Controller.

requirements.title: Bridge idempotent close
requirements.text: ddsbr.Bridge.Close shall stop the command-forwarding goroutine, wait for it to exit, and be idempotent; repeated calls after the first shall return without blocking or panicking.

requirements.title: Topic not found error
requirements.text: ddsbr.Domain.Lookup shall return ErrTopicNotFound when no topic with the requested name has been registered.
Broker routes PUBLISH messages to all matching subscribers on a topic.
requirements.title: Broker routes PUBLISH messages to all matching subscribers on a topic.

requirements.text: mqttbr.Client.Subscribe shall return the same channel for repeated Subscribe calls on the same topic from the same Client.
requirements.title: Client.Subscribe is idempotent per topic

requirements.text: mqttbr.Client.Unsubscribe shall remove the subscription so no further messages published to that topic are delivered to it.
requirements.title: Client.Unsubscribe stops delivery

requirements.text: mqttbr.Bridge.PublishResponse shall publish an acf.Message response to the status topic in a wire format mqttbr.DecodeStatus parses back as a non-trigger StatusMessage.
requirements.title: Bridge.PublishResponse publishes a decodable status message

requirements.text: mqttbr.Bridge.PublishTrigger shall publish a trigger-event count to the status topic in a wire format mqttbr.DecodeStatus parses back as a trigger StatusMessage with the correct Count.
requirements.title: Bridge.PublishTrigger publishes a decodable trigger message

requirements.text: mqttbr.Bridge shall decode command messages arriving on the command topic (via mqttbr.EncodeCommand's wire format) and forward each as a request to the upstream *udp.Controller.
requirements.title: Bridge command dispatch

requirements.text: Client.Close unsubscribes from all topics idempotently.
requirements.title: Client.Close unsubscribes from all topics idempotently.

requirements.text: Bridge.Close stops background goroutines and is idempotent.
requirements.title: Bridge.Close stops background goroutines and is idempotent.

requirements.text: linbr.EncodeFrame shall serialize a Frame using ChecksumClassic into [protected ID][data...][checksum] wire bytes that linbr.DecodeFrame parses back to the same ID and Data.
requirements.title: EncodeFrame produces PID+data+classic-checksum wire bytes

requirements.text: linbr.DecodeFrame shall return ErrChecksumMismatch when the trailing checksum byte does not match the checksum computed over the frame's protected ID/data.
requirements.title: DecodeFrame detects a corrupted checksum

requirements.text: linbr's ChecksumEnhanced checksum (which folds in the protected ID byte) shall differ from ChecksumClassic for the same Frame, such that decoding an enhanced-checksum-encoded frame as ChecksumClassic fails with ErrChecksumMismatch.
requirements.title: Enhanced checksum is not interchangeable with classic

requirements.text: linbr.EncodeFrame shall return ErrDataTooLong for a Frame whose Data exceeds the 8-byte LIN classic/enhanced frame payload limit, without producing any wire bytes.
requirements.title: EncodeFrame rejects oversized data

requirements.text: linbr.DecodeFrame shall return ErrFrameTooShort for a buffer under 2 bytes, which cannot hold both a protected ID byte and a checksum byte.
requirements.title: DecodeFrame rejects undersized buffers

requirements.text: linbr.ScheduleTable.Next shall return each configured ScheduleEntry in order, wrap back to the first entry after the last, and report ok = false only when the table has no entries at all.
requirements.title: ScheduleTable.Next round-robins through its entries

requirements.text: linbr.Controller.Transfer shall encode a Frame (see EncodeFrame), send it as a write request through the wrapped lin.Endpoint's raw byte-pass-through transfer, and decode the echoed response body back into a Frame with linbr.DecodeFrame.
requirements.title: Controller.Transfer round-trips through a real LIN endpoint

requirements.text: StateSequence generates exactly n states starting from the initial state.
StateSequence applies the Generator at each step, producing correct intermediate states.
Always returns true when the predicate holds in every state of the trace.
Always returns false when the predicate fails in at least one state.
Eventually returns true when the predicate holds in at least one state of the trace.
Eventually returns false when the predicate holds in no state of the trace.
Until holds when predicate p holds continuously until predicate q becomes true.
Checker.Check returns ViolationError naming the first falsified invariant.
LifecycleTrace produces exactly len(actions)+1 states and a plausible action sequence satisfies LifecycleInvariants (rank never decreases, eventually reaches FullyConfigured).
An out-of-order lifecycle transition attempt never advances LifecycleRank, satisfying the rank-never-decreases invariant while never satisfying the eventually-fully-configured invariant.
LifecycleRank orders Unconfigured, HWLocked, and FullyConfigured strictly increasing.

A full StandBy/Normal/Sleep/Normal wake cycle paced by powerstate.Driver satisfies PowerInvariants: PowerUnpowered is never observed, the wake-handshake retransmission queue eventually drains, and a Sleep-to-Normal wake eventually determines a cold/hot-start kind.
After a full wake cycle, the endpoint's final observed power state is Normal and the Driver's final pending retransmission count is zero.
PowerTrace produces exactly len(actions)+1 states.

An Observe-then-silence-past-timeout-then-Observe sequence satisfies TimeoutInvariants: the verdict clears after activity, trips once the configured timeout elapses, and clears again by the trace's end.
A sequence-monotonicity violation followed by Reset satisfies MonotonicityInvariants: the verdict trips on the violation, stays tripped (sticky) through subsequent arrivals, and clears after Reset.
A stream Supervisor has never observed at all is judged in-safe-state from its very first snapshot, with no implicit grace period.
ComputeRisk returns the correct risk value as the product of impact and attack feasibility ratings.
ComputeRisk classifies risk values as Low (≤2), Medium (≤6), High (≤12), or Critical (>12).
ComputeRisk returns ErrInvalidRating when the impact rating is outside the 1–4 range.
ComputeRisk returns ErrInvalidRating when the feasibility rating is outside the 1–4 range.
ThreatScenario.RiskValue delegates to ComputeRisk using its own Impact and Feasibility fields.
TARA.HighRiskThreats returns only ThreatScenarios rated High or Critical.
GoalRegistry.Unsatisfied returns only CybersecurityGoals with Satisfied=false.
GoalRegistry.Unsatisfied returns an empty slice when all goals are satisfied.
GoalRegistry.All returns every registered goal regardless of Satisfied state.
BuildTARA's every ThreatScenario carries a unique ID, a non-empty DamageScenario, and a valid Impact/Feasibility rating.
BuildTARA identifies at least one High-or-Critical risk threat in the TC18 attack surface.
BuildGoalRegistry maps a CybersecurityGoal to every threat BuildTARA defines, and reports at least one genuinely unsatisfied goal.
Registry.Add registers a requirement so that All returns it.
Registry.SetMet marks a registered requirement as met, reflected in Analyze.
Registry.SetMet returns an error when the requirement ID is not registered.
Analyze returns Total=0 and ComplianceRatio=0 for an empty registry.
Analyze with empty targetASIL includes requirements of all ASIL levels.
Analyze with a specific targetASIL excludes requirements of other levels.
GapReport.ComplianceRatio equals MetCount divided by Total.
StandardASILDGaps returns exactly 8 predefined ASIL-D gap requirements.
BuildRequirementFamilies returns unique, ASIL-B-targeted, Met Requirements, one per REQ-* family Milestones 44-57 produced.
BuildRegistry's Analyze(ASILB) reports zero gaps and full compliance, while Analyze(ASILD) reports exactly StandardASILDGaps' items as the gap.

requirements.title: SpecVersion exports the RELAY specification version
requirements.text: The package-level constant SpecVersion shall equal relay.SpecVersion, declaring the RELAY spec version this package implements per spec §17.12.

requirements.title: EndpointIDString/ParseEndpointID round trip
requirements.text: ParseEndpointID(EndpointIDString(addr)) shall return addr unchanged for every valid avtp.ByteBusID value (0-255).

requirements.title: ParseEndpointID rejects invalid input
requirements.text: ParseEndpointID shall return ErrNotFound for a string that does not parse as a decimal integer in [0, 255].

requirements.title: ResponseToMessage sets Protocol to relay.RCP
requirements.text: ResponseToMessage shall set the returned relay.Message's Protocol field to relay.RCP.

requirements.title: ResponseToMessage maps addr to ID via EndpointIDString
requirements.text: ResponseToMessage shall set the returned relay.Message's ID field to EndpointIDString(addr).

requirements.title: ResponseToMessage preserves the response Body as Payload
requirements.text: ResponseToMessage shall set the returned relay.Message's Payload field to the input acf.Message's Body, unchanged.

requirements.title: ResponseToMessage sets rcp.error meta field
requirements.text: ResponseToMessage shall set the returned relay.Message's Meta["rcp.error"] field to the string form of the input acf.Message's Control.Has(acf.FlagError) bit.

requirements.title: RequestFromMessage parses the endpoint address from relay.Message.ID
requirements.text: RequestFromMessage shall derive the returned avtp.ByteBusID from m.ID via ParseEndpointID, returning its error unchanged on failure.

requirements.title: RequestFromMessage derives control flags from rcp.op / payload presence
requirements.text: RequestFromMessage shall set acf.FlagRead or acf.FlagWrite from the "rcp.op" Meta key ("read"/"write"); when absent or unrecognised it shall default to acf.FlagWrite when m.Payload is non-empty, else acf.FlagRead.

requirements.title: Adapt wraps Controller as relay.Caller without blocking
requirements.text: Adapt(c Controller) relay.Caller shall return immediately, wrapping c in an adapter satisfying relay.Caller. It shall not establish a connection or block. Controller is the narrow StreamID/Request/Close interface *udp.Controller and *mock.Client both satisfy.

requirements.title: adapter.Protocol returns relay.RCP
requirements.text: The adapter returned by Adapt shall return relay.RCP from its Protocol() method.

requirements.title: adapter.Send converts relay.Message to a request and dispatches it
requirements.text: Send shall convert msg via RequestFromMessage and dispatch it through Controller.Request, discarding the response.

requirements.title: adapter.Call returns relay.Message from the endpoint response
requirements.text: Call shall convert req via RequestFromMessage, dispatch it through Controller.Request, and return ResponseToMessage(addr, resp) on success.

requirements.title: adapter.Subscribe returns a lifecycle-compliant channel
requirements.text: Subscribe shall return a channel obeying RELAY §6 (independent per call, closed on adapter Close, ErrClosed once already closed); it shall never itself deliver a message, since TC18 has no server-initiated broadcast.

requirements.title: adapter.Subscribe applies SubscriberConfig channel depth
requirements.text: Subscribe shall size its returned channel's buffer per relay.ApplySubscriberOpts' resolved ChanDepth.

requirements.title: adapter.Subscribe supports multiple independent subscriptions
requirements.text: Subscribe shall be safe to call multiple times, each call returning an independent channel; closing the adapter shall close every one.

requirements.title: adapter.Close closes every Subscribe channel and the Controller
requirements.text: Close shall close every channel returned by a prior Subscribe call and then close the underlying Controller.

requirements.title: go-rcp version --format json emits VersionDocument
requirements.text: The go-rcp binary version command with --format json shall emit a JSON object conforming to RELAY spec §12.1 with tool, protocol, protocol_int, version, spec_version, language, and runtime fields.

requirements.title: go-rcp capabilities emits CapabilitiesDocument
requirements.text: The go-rcp binary capabilities command shall emit a JSON object conforming to RELAY spec §12.2 including kind, tool, protocol, commands, transports, features, interfaces, optional_interfaces, and adapt fields.

requirements.title: go-rcp status --format json emits StatusDocument
requirements.text: The go-rcp binary status command with --format json shall emit a JSON object conforming to RELAY spec §12.3 with protocol, tool, version, healthy, connected, endpoint, and details fields.

requirements.title: ServeBackground tracks Serve in WaitGroup before launching goroutine
requirements.text: ServeBackground() shall call wg.Add(1) synchronously before starting the Serve goroutine so that Close().wg.Wait() correctly blocks until Serve exits, avoiding data races on the WaitGroup.

requirements.title: Adapter implements relay.HealthProvider
requirements.text: The Adapt() result shall implement relay.HealthProvider, returning relay.Health from Health().

requirements.title: Health reflects closed and error state
requirements.text: Health() shall return HealthDown when the adapter is closed, HealthDegraded when errors have been recorded while open, and HealthOK otherwise.

requirements.title: Adapter implements relay.MetricsProvider
requirements.text: The Adapt() result shall implement relay.MetricsProvider, returning relay.Metrics from Metrics().

requirements.title: Metrics count writes, deliveries, drops, bytes and errors
requirements.text: Metrics() shall report WriteCount, DeliverCount, DropCount, BytesWritten, BytesDelivered and ErrorCount accumulated across Send, Call and Subscribe.

requirements.title: Adapter implements relay.Drainer
requirements.text: The Adapt() result shall implement relay.Drainer via CloseWithDrain(ctx).

requirements.title: CloseWithDrain waits for in-flight dispatches
requirements.text: CloseWithDrain shall block until in-flight Send/Call dispatches complete, then close; if ctx expires first it shall close immediately and return ctx.Err().

requirements.title: ResponseToMessage conforms to the generic relay.Message envelope
requirements.text: ResponseToMessage's output shall set Protocol, ID, Payload, and a non-zero Timestamp per the RELAY spec §4.2/§15.7.5 generic envelope contract.

requirements.title: RELAY canonical schemas reachable
requirements.text: go-RCP shall build against a RELAY module exposing the §15 canonical-type JSON schemas (rcp-command, rcp-status) via relay.Schema(), confirming adoption of spec v0.3 artifacts.

requirements.title: SpecVersion sourced from RELAY module
requirements.text: The exported SpecVersion shall equal relay.SpecVersion (not hardcoded) and be non-empty, per spec §17.12/§19.4.

requirements.title: go-rcp convert drives ResponseToMessage for RELAY interop
requirements.text: go-rcp convert --protocol RCP shall decode one {byte_bus_id, body, error} JSON envelope from stdin and write ResponseToMessage's JSON output to stdout, per RELAY spec §11.2.

requirements.title: go-rcp send --format json is a streaming relay.Message NDJSON sink
requirements.text: The go-rcp binary send command with --format json shall read relay.Message values as NDJSON on stdin (one per line), convert each via CommandFromMessage and publish it to the matching zone controller until EOF, serving as the crossbar egress sink (RELAY spec §11.2). Malformed or undeliverable lines shall be reported to stderr and skipped without aborting; it shall exit 0 on clean EOF and 1 only on a stdin read error.

requirements.title: Untimed (NTSCF) AVTPDU header round-trips all fields
requirements.text: avtp.EncodeHeader followed by avtp.DecodeHeader shall reproduce an identical untimed (NTSCF) Header. StreamIDValid, SequenceNum, DataLength, and StreamID shall survive the round-trip byte-for-byte.

requirements.title: Timestamped (TSCF) AVTPDU header round-trips all fields
requirements.text: avtp.EncodeHeader followed by avtp.DecodeHeader shall reproduce an identical timestamped (TSCF) Header, including the presentation Timestamp and TimestampStatus marker, in addition to the fields shared with the untimed variant. TimestampInvalid is the one exception: TC18 Figure 5 gives the wire no way to distinguish it from TimestampMissing (both are tv=0), so it shall round-trip as TimestampMissing, which Header.Disposition treats identically.

requirements.title: Header decode rejects buffers shorter than the applicable header length
requirements.text: avtp.DecodeHeader shall return ErrShortHeader when the supplied buffer is shorter than the header length implied by its subtype (untimed or timestamped), so that no caller reads beyond the buffer bounds when parsing an AVTPDU header.

requirements.title: Header decode rejects an unsupported protocol version
requirements.text: avtp.DecodeHeader shall return ErrUnsupportedVersion when the header's version bits do not equal avtp.ProtocolVersion, so that a frame from an incompatible AVTPDU revision is not misinterpreted.

requirements.title: Header decode rejects nonzero reserved bits
requirements.text: avtp.DecodeHeader shall return ErrReservedBitsSet when any bit TC18 §11.1 p.22 marks reserved within the AVTPDU header's first (subtype-data) quadlet is nonzero: the untimed header's r bit (Figure 6, bit 12), and the timestamped header's rsv field (Figure 5, bits 13-14) and reserved bits 24-30.

requirements.title: StreamID round-trips sender MAC and locally-assigned suffix
requirements.text: avtp.NewStreamID followed by StreamID.MAC and StreamID.Suffix shall reproduce the exact 6-byte MAC address and 2-byte suffix the StreamID was constructed from.

requirements.title: Disposition schedules a valid, time-sync-supported timestamped header
requirements.text: Header.Disposition shall return DispositionScheduled only when the header is timestamped (Timed true), its TimestampStatus is TimestampValid, and the caller reports time-sync support.

requirements.title: Disposition folds a missing, invalid, or uncertain timestamp marker down to best-effort
requirements.text: Header.Disposition shall return DispositionBestEffort for a timestamped header whose TimestampStatus is TimestampMissing, TimestampInvalid, or TimestampUncertain, when the caller reports time-sync support.

requirements.title: Disposition drops a timestamped header when the server has no time-sync support
requirements.text: Header.Disposition shall return DispositionDrop for any timestamped (Timed true) header when the caller reports no time-sync support, regardless of the header's TimestampStatus marker.

requirements.title: Disposition treats every untimed header as best-effort
requirements.text: Header.Disposition shall return DispositionBestEffort for an untimed (Timed false) header unconditionally, regardless of the time-sync-support argument.

requirements.title: Short-form (ACF_ABB) RCP message round-trips with no timestamp field on the wire
requirements.text: avtp.EncodeMessage followed by avtp.DecodeMessage shall reproduce an identical Message of MessageKind KindShort, and the encoded bytes shall be exactly the 10-byte request-descriptor header plus the body, with no 64-bit timestamp slot present.

requirements.title: Long-form (ACF_GBB) RCP message round-trips including its 64-bit timestamp slot
requirements.text: avtp.EncodeMessage followed by avtp.DecodeMessage shall reproduce an identical Message of MessageKind KindLong, including the 64-bit Timestamp field carried immediately after the shared request-descriptor header.

requirements.title: Control flags and the dual-purpose read-size/segment-number field round-trip correctly
requirements.text: avtp.EncodeMessage/DecodeMessage shall preserve every combination of the Ack, Read, Write, Response, Error, and MoreSegments control bits, and Message.SegmentNumber/Message.ReadSize shall interpret ReadSizeOrSegment as a segment number when MoreSegments is set and as a read size otherwise.

requirements.title: Message decode rejects malformed input without misreading it
requirements.text: avtp.DecodeMessage shall return ErrShortMessage for a buffer shorter than its declared length (including a truncated 64-bit timestamp slot on a KindLong message), ErrUnknownMessageKind for an unrecognized kind tag, and ErrReservedBitsSet for nonzero reserved pad or control bits.

requirements.title: A full Frame round-trips for every header-variant / message-kind combination
requirements.text: avtp.EncodeFrame followed by avtp.DecodeFrame shall reproduce an identical Frame for all four combinations of untimed/timestamped Header and short-form/long-form Message, with the AVTPDU's DataLength field always derived from the encoded message rather than trusted from the caller.

requirements.title: Decoders never panic on arbitrary input, and golden vectors freeze the wire encoding
requirements.text: avtp.DecodeHeader, DecodeMessage, and DecodeFrame shall return an error or a valid value for any arbitrary byte slice and shall never panic or slice out of bounds, as verified by fuzz testing; in addition, a fixed set of golden byte-vector fixtures shall pin the exact encoding of representative server requests so later milestones can regression-test against a frozen wire format.

requirements.title: Encoded AVTPDU headers match TC18 Figures 5 and 6 byte-for-byte
requirements.text: avtp.EncodeHeader shall produce exactly the octet layouts defined by OPEN Alliance TC18 Remote Control Protocol Specification v0.5.1_RC §11.1 p.22. An untimed header shall be 12 octets: one quadlet packing subtype(8) | sv(1) | version(3) | r(1) | ntscf_data_length(11) | sequence_num(8) per Figure 6, immediately followed by the 64-bit stream_id with no reserved gap. A timestamped header shall be 24 octets: the Figure 5 subtype-data quadlet packing subtype(8) | sv(1) | version(3) | mr(1) | rsv(2) | tv(1) | sequence_num(8) | reserved(7) | tu(1), then stream_id(64), avtp_timestamp(32), the reserved format-specific quadlet(32), and a quadlet carrying stream_data_length(16) followed by 16 reserved bits.

requirements.title: AVTPDU subtype tags carry the specification's own values
requirements.text: avtp.SubtypeNTSCF shall equal 0x82 and avtp.SubtypeTSCF shall equal 0x05, the values labelled on the subtype field of TC18 §11.1 p.22 Figure 6 and Figure 5 respectively, so that a frame this package emits is recognised as the intended AVTPDU control format by a conformant peer.

requirements.title: The timestamped header's timestamp marker is carried by TC18's separate tv and tu bits
requirements.text: avtp.EncodeHeader shall encode Header.TimestampStatus into the two single-bit fields TC18 Figure 5 defines for it — tv (bit 15) and tu (bit 31) — as TimestampValid: tv=1,tu=0; TimestampUncertain: tv=1,tu=1; TimestampMissing and TimestampInvalid: tv=0,tu=0. avtp.DecodeHeader shall report tv=0 as TimestampMissing regardless of tu, tv=1 with tu=0 as TimestampValid, and tv=1 with tu=1 as TimestampUncertain.

requirements.title: A timestamped header's stream_data_length decodes at its full 16-bit width
requirements.text: avtp.DecodeHeader shall read a timestamped (TSCF) header's stream_data_length as the full 16-bit field TC18 Figure 5 defines, without masking it to the narrower 11-bit width of the untimed header's ntscf_data_length, so that a conformant peer's larger frame is reported accurately rather than silently truncated.

requirements.title: New Server starts in StateUnconfigured with an empty register map
requirements.text: server.NewServer shall return a Server in StateUnconfigured with no endpoints declared, an empty pin-mapping table, and zero-value stream/queue configuration.

requirements.title: AdvanceToHWLocked succeeds and locks in a plausible pin map
requirements.text: Server.AdvanceToHWLocked shall transition a Server from StateUnconfigured to StateHWLocked when its pin-mapping table passes PinMap.Validate.

requirements.title: PinMap.Validate rejects a duplicate physical pin assignment
requirements.text: PinMap.Validate shall return ErrPinMapInvalid when two assignments in the table claim the same physical pin.

requirements.title: AdvanceToHWLocked rejects a pin map referencing an undeclared endpoint
requirements.text: Server.AdvanceToHWLocked shall return ErrPinMapInvalid, and leave the lifecycle state unchanged, when the pin-mapping table references a byte_bus_id that was never declared via Server.AddEndpoint.

requirements.title: AdvanceToFullyConfigured succeeds once every endpoint and the queue configuration are plausible
requirements.text: Server.AdvanceToFullyConfigured shall transition a Server from StateHWLocked to StateFullyConfigured once every declared endpoint has a non-empty functional configuration block and QueueConfig.Validate passes.

requirements.title: AdvanceToFullyConfigured rejects an endpoint with no functional configuration
requirements.text: Server.AdvanceToFullyConfigured shall return ErrFunctionalBlockIncomplete, and leave the lifecycle state unchanged, when any declared endpoint still has an empty FunctionalBlock.

requirements.title: AdvanceToFullyConfigured rejects a queue configuration that can never flush
requirements.text: Server.AdvanceToFullyConfigured shall return ErrQueueConfigInvalid when QueueConfig has both FlushThreshold and FlushTimeMillis set to zero.

requirements.title: Lifecycle transitions cannot skip a state
requirements.text: Server.AdvanceToFullyConfigured shall return ErrLifecycleOutOfOrder, and leave the lifecycle state unchanged, when called while the Server is still StateUnconfigured.

requirements.title: The pin-mapping table is locked once the server leaves StateUnconfigured
requirements.text: Server.SetPinAssignment shall return ErrRegisterLocked when called while the Server is not StateUnconfigured, even for the root client.

requirements.title: Functional configuration blocks stay writable via an authorized requester once fully configured
requirements.text: Server.WriteFunctional and Server.WriteEP0 shall continue to accept a change to an endpoint's functional configuration block once the Server reaches StateFullyConfigured, for the root client or a stream with an explicit grant for that endpoint, while Server.SetStreamLimits and Server.SetQueueConfig shall return ErrRegisterLocked for any requester once that state is reached.

requirements.title: The general server register block is never client-writable
requirements.text: Server.WriteEP0 shall return ErrGeneralBlockReadOnly when the incoming whole-map write changes any identification, protocol-version, or capability/capacity field of GeneralBlock.

requirements.title: EP0 whole-map read round-trips the configured register map
requirements.text: Server.ReadEP0 followed by DecodeRegisterMap shall reproduce every declared endpoint's GenericEndpointBlock and FunctionalBlock, and the configured pin-mapping table, byte-for-byte.

requirements.title: The root client can write the whole register map before it is fully configured
requirements.text: Server.WriteEP0 shall apply an incoming register map for the root-client stream when the Server has not yet reached StateFullyConfigured.

requirements.title: A whole-map write is denied to any stream that is not the root client
requirements.text: Server.WriteEP0 shall return ErrNotRootClient when called by a stream that has not claimed the root-client role via Server.ClaimRoot.

requirements.title: A restricted stream can read and write an endpoint explicitly granted to it
requirements.text: Server.ReadEndpoint and Server.WriteFunctional shall succeed for a non-root stream when that endpoint's address has been granted to it via Server.Grant.

requirements.title: A restricted stream is denied access to an endpoint that was never granted to it
requirements.text: Server.ReadEndpoint and Server.WriteFunctional shall return ErrAccessDenied for a non-root stream addressing an endpoint it was never granted via Server.Grant.

requirements.title: The root-client role is exclusive to one stream at a time
requirements.text: AccessController.ClaimRoot shall return ErrRootAlreadyClaimed when a stream other than the current root client attempts to claim the role, and shall succeed idempotently when the current root client re-claims it.

requirements.title: GeneralBlock round-trips all fields through Encode/DecodeGeneralBlock
requirements.text: EncodeGeneralBlock followed by DecodeGeneralBlock shall reproduce an identical GeneralBlock: identification fields, register-map version, capability/capacity counters, and the four configuration-table pointers shall all survive the round-trip byte-for-byte.

requirements.title: PinMap.Validate rejects a named-signal index out of range for its endpoint's declared type
requirements.text: PinMap.Validate shall return ErrPinMapInvalid when an assignment's SignalIndex is not a valid index into SignalName for its Endpoint's declared EndpointType.

requirements.title: Register-map decoders never panic on arbitrary input, and golden vectors freeze the whole-map encoding
requirements.text: DecodeGeneralBlock and DecodeRegisterMap shall return an error or a valid value for any arbitrary byte slice and shall never panic or slice out of bounds, as verified by fuzz testing; in addition, a fixed golden byte-vector fixture shall pin the exact whole-register-map encoding EncodeRegisterMap produces for a representative configuration so later milestones can regression-test against a frozen register-map format.

requirements.title: ReadDiscovery answers in every lifecycle state and regardless of access grants
requirements.text: Server.ReadDiscovery shall return the whole encoded register map for a calling stream regardless of the server's current LifecycleState (StateUnconfigured, StateHWLocked, or StateFullyConfigured) and regardless of whether that stream is the root client or holds any AccessController grant for EP0.

requirements.title: Discovery reads remain available to other streams while one stream holds the configuration claim
requirements.text: Server.ReadDiscovery shall continue to succeed for any calling stream even while a different stream holds an active Discovery-stream configuration claim (Server.ClaimConfiguration); the configuration claim shall never block a concurrent discovery read.

requirements.title: HandleDiscoveryRequest rejects a timestamped (TSCF) discovery request
requirements.text: Server.HandleDiscoveryRequest shall return ErrDiscoveryRequiresUntimedHeader, and no register-map bytes, when given an avtp.Header with Timed set to true.

requirements.title: HandleDiscoveryRequest answers an untimed (NTSCF) discovery request
requirements.text: Server.HandleDiscoveryRequest shall return the same bytes as Server.ReadDiscovery, with no error, when given an avtp.Header with Timed set to false.

requirements.title: ClaimConfiguration reserves configuration rights for the first stream and denies a different stream
requirements.text: Server.ClaimConfiguration shall succeed for the first stream to call it, and shall return ErrConfigurationClaimed when a different stream calls it while that reservation remains unexpired.

requirements.title: ClaimConfiguration is idempotent and renews the timeout for the claim-holding stream
requirements.text: Server.ClaimConfiguration shall succeed when called again by the stream that already holds the active configuration claim, and shall extend the claim's expiry by a full configuration-claim-timeout window measured from that call.

requirements.title: An expired configuration claim can be reclaimed by a different stream
requirements.text: Server.ClaimConfiguration shall succeed for a different stream once the current claim holder's configuration-claim-timeout has elapsed with no follow-up configuration request, and Server.ConfigurationClaimant shall report no active claimant once the timeout has elapsed and before any stream reclaims it.

requirements.title: ReleaseConfigurationClaim releases the holder's claim early and rejects a non-holder
requirements.text: Server.ReleaseConfigurationClaim shall clear an active configuration claim when called by its current holder, and shall return ErrNotConfigurationClaimant when called by any stream that is not the current active claim holder.

requirements.title: IsConformantServer recognizes a genuine server's identification, version, and vendor/product fields
requirements.text: IsConformantServer shall return true for a GeneralBlock whose RegisterMapVersion matches this package's supported RegisterMapVersion and whose VendorID and ProductID are both nonzero, and shall return false if any of those conditions does not hold.

requirements.title: DiscoverTopology and WriteTopology/ReadTopology round-trip a discovered server's persisted topology
requirements.text: DiscoverTopology shall extract a Topology whose VendorID, ProductID, RegisterMapVersion, and per-endpoint Address/Type entries match the source RegisterMap; WriteTopology followed by ReadTopology shall reproduce an equal Topology value.

requirements.title: DemoteToUnconfigured reverses StateHWLocked back to StateUnconfigured for an authorized requester only
requirements.text: Server.DemoteToUnconfigured shall transition the Server from StateHWLocked to StateUnconfigured and leave declared endpoints, pin assignments, and functional blocks unchanged when requester is the root client or the current Discovery-stream configuration claimant; it shall return ErrDemotionNotAuthorized for any other requester and ErrLifecycleOutOfOrder when the Server is not in StateHWLocked, leaving the state unchanged in both rejection cases.

requirements.title: ApplyConfigRequest/WriteFunctionalAt implement TC18 §12.7.1 offset-addressed configuration access
requirements.text: server.Server.ApplyConfigRequest shall patch the caller-supplied EP_func block at the configuration request's relative start address, adopt and persist the patched block only if the endpoint accepts it, and restore the previous block if persisting fails; for a read it shall return the EP_func bytes at that start address, bounded by the request's read_size and clamped to the end of the block. Both it and server.Server.WriteFunctionalAt shall silently ignore, in full, any write whose start address plus data length exceeds the block's length, per TC18 §12.7.1: "Any byte_msg_payload for which the length plus the start_address results in a value larger than the EP_LEN, is to be ignored".

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces pin-count and active-pin-mask bounds
requirements.text: gpio.Config.Validate shall return ErrPinCountOutOfRange when PinCount is zero or exceeds MaxPins, or when Direction or TriggerEnable sets any bit outside the active-pin mask ((1<<PinCount)-1).

requirements.title: evt[2:0] selects the write semantic per TC18 Table 30, and reserved 100b is rejected
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall take the write semantic of a write request from the request's evt[2:0] field per TC18 §13.5 Table 30's GPIO/PWM_OUT row — 000b set, 001b bitwise OR, 010b bitwise AND, 011b bitwise XOR, 101b saturating add, 110b saturating subtract, 111b configuration change — and shall never take it from a byte of the request body. It shall reject evt[2:0] = 100b with acf.ErrEVTReserved (error code UNSUPPORTED_CMD) without altering any pin, reject a request whose evt[2:0] is non-zero and whose byte_msg_payload is absent with acf.ErrEVTMissingPayload per §12.9.1, and reject a write request whose body is not exactly four bytes with ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes (error code INVALID_PARAMETER) per §13.7.4.1.

requirements.title: Combining semantics affect only output-direction pins
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall apply the evt[2:0]-selected set/OR/AND/XOR combining rules to only the output-direction pins (Config.Direction bits set), leaving every input-direction pin's value unchanged.

requirements.title: Saturating semantics clamp instead of wrapping, and subtract in the specified operand order
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall clamp the evt[2:0] = 101b saturating add at the endpoint's active-pin mask and the evt[2:0] = 110b saturating subtract at zero, rather than wrapping on overflow/underflow, per TC18 §13.5 Table 30's note that "neither overflows nor wrap-arounds shall occur"; the subtraction shall compute byte_msg_payload minus current interface status, in that order, per the same table's normative wording for 110b.

requirements.title: evt[2:0] = 111b changes the endpoint configuration and is not presented at the pins
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall, for a request with evt[2:0] = 111b, treat the byte_msg_payload as a TC18 §12.7.1 configuration access into the endpoint's EP_func block (a relative register start address followed by configuration data) rather than presenting it at the pins, persist an accepted configuration through server.Server.WriteFunctional, adopt it for subsequent requests, and leave the pin value unchanged.

requirements.title: HandleRequest routes Read/Write and rejects neither
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return the endpoint's current pin value for a request with FlagRead set, the resulting pin value for a request with FlagWrite set, and ErrRequestMustReadOrWrite for a request with neither flag set.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects the wrong endpoint or an ungranted stream
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrWrongEndpoint when a request's ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and shall return the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant for the endpoint.

requirements.title: Triggers queue only for TriggerEnable pins
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint shall queue a TriggerEvent only when a pin whose Config.TriggerEnable bit is set changes value, and shall not queue an event for a change confined to non-trigger pins.

requirements.title: SetInputs only drives input-direction pins
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint.SetInputs shall drive only the endpoint's input-direction pins from its mask argument, leaving every output-direction pin's value unchanged, and shall queue trigger events for input-pin changes the same way a write does.

requirements.title: DrainTriggers returns events FIFO and clears the queue
requirements.text: gpio.Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return every queued TriggerEvent in the order it was recorded, clear the queue, and return nil when no events are pending.

requirements.title: GPIO encoders/decoders round-trip and never panic
requirements.text: gpio.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig and gpio.EncodeWriteRequest/DecodeWriteRequest/DecodeValue shall round-trip their respective structures and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer. A write request body shall be exactly four bytes — the operand bitmask alone, with no in-band semantic selector byte.

requirements.title: GPIO golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: gpio.EncodeConfig and gpio.EncodeWriteRequest/EncodeValue shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input, with the four-byte write-request body carrying no semantic selector byte.

requirements.title: Channel.Valid recognizes exactly the six defined channels
requirements.text: spi.Channel.Valid shall return true for exactly Channel0 through Channel5 (MaxChannels) and false for any other value.

requirements.title: SetChannelConfig isolates one channel's configuration
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint.SetChannelConfig shall persist the given ChannelConfig for exactly the selected channel through server.Server.WriteFunctional, leaving every other channel's configuration in the persisted register map unchanged.

requirements.title: Mode.Valid recognizes exactly the four defined clock modes
requirements.text: spi.Mode.Valid shall return true for exactly Mode0 through Mode3 and false for any other value.

requirements.title: HandleRequest dispatches by the evt[2:0] channel selector and rejects an unconfigured channel
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall dispatch a transfer request to the chip-select channel named by the request's evt[2:0] field per TC18 §13.5 Table 30's SPI row ("selects channel 0 … 5"), and shall never take the channel from a byte of the request body; it shall return ErrChannelNotConfigured when that channel's ChannelConfig.Enabled is false.

requirements.title: HandleRequest requires Write, the right endpoint, and access
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustWrite when a request does not set FlagWrite, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: A configured Transport performs the transfer, defaulting to loopback
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall perform a channel's transfer through its configured Transport when one is set via SetTransport, and shall default to a loopback echo of the transmitted bytes when none is set.

requirements.title: Every transfer queues a transfer-complete trigger with its byte count
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint shall queue a TriggerTransferComplete event carrying the number of bytes received for every completed transfer.

requirements.title: Chip-select-edge triggers bracket each transfer in order
requirements.text: spi.Endpoint shall queue a TriggerChipSelectEdge asserted event immediately before, and a deasserted event immediately after, each transfer's byte exchange, and spi.Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return all queued events in that recorded order.

requirements.title: Config.Validate rejects an implausible channel and round-trips all slots
requirements.text: spi.Config.Validate shall return ErrZeroClock or ErrInvalidMode for any enabled channel with a zero clock rate or an unrecognized Mode, and spi.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip all MaxChannels channel slots including disabled ones.

requirements.title: SPI decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: spi.DecodeConfig shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer, and spi.DecodeTransferRequest/DecodeTransferResponse shall never panic on arbitrary input — every byte sequence, including the empty one, is a structurally valid SPI payload.

requirements.title: SPI golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: spi.EncodeConfig and spi.EncodeTransferRequest shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input, with the transfer-request body carrying the SPI payload alone and no leading channel sub-opcode byte.

requirements.title: SPI applies TC18 Table 30's SPI row and §12.9.1 to every request
requirements.text: spi.EVTClass shall be acf.EVTClassChannelSelect, and spi.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall route every request through acf.Message.EVTDisposition: it shall reach each of the six channels via evt[2:0] = 000b..101b, reject evt[2:0] = 110b with acf.ErrEVTReserved without performing any bus transfer, reject a non-zero evt[2:0] with no byte_msg_payload with acf.ErrEVTMissingPayload, and treat evt[2:0] = 111b as a TC18 §12.7.1 configuration access that is not presented on any SPI bus.

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces bus speed validity when enabled
requirements.text: i2c.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled bus regardless of Speed, and shall return ErrInvalidSpeed for an enabled bus whose Speed is not one of this package's five recognized values.

requirements.title: BusSpeed.Valid recognizes exactly the five defined speed classes
requirements.text: i2c.BusSpeed.Valid shall return true for exactly SpeedStandard through SpeedUltraFast and false for any other value; this package's numbering is its own reasoned resolution of an ambiguous/colliding bus-speed enumeration in the source behavioral description, flagged as an open item pending confirmation against a public interoperability reference.

requirements.title: I2C Config encoders/decoders round-trip and never panic
requirements.text: i2c.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config value and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: HandleRequest requires Write, the right endpoint, and access
requirements.text: i2c.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrRequestMustWrite when a request does not set FlagWrite, ErrWrongEndpoint when its ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, and the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects a transfer against a disabled bus
requirements.text: i2c.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrBusNotConfigured when a transfer request is handled against an endpoint whose Config.Enabled is false.

requirements.title: A configured Transport performs the transfer, defaulting to loopback
requirements.text: i2c.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall perform a transfer through its configured Transport when one is set via SetTransport, and shall default to a loopback echo of the transmitted bytes when none is set.

requirements.title: Every transfer queues a transaction-complete trigger with its byte count
requirements.text: i2c.Endpoint shall queue a TriggerEvent carrying the number of bytes received for every completed transfer, and Endpoint.DrainTriggers shall return queued events in FIFO order and clear the queue.

requirements.title: I2C decoders never panic on malformed input
requirements.text: i2c.DecodeConfig and i2c.DecodeTransferRequest shall never panic on arbitrary input, including empty and truncated buffers.

requirements.title: I2C golden vectors pin the frozen wire byte layout
requirements.text: i2c.EncodeConfig and i2c.EncodeTransferRequest shall produce the exact frozen byte sequences pinned by this package's golden-vector tests for a fixed representative input.

requirements.title: I²C applies TC18 Table 30’s config-only row and §12.9.1 to every request
requirements.text: i2c.EVTClass shall be acf.EVTClassConfigOnly, and i2c.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall route every request through acf.Message.EVTDisposition: it shall reject evt[2:0] = 001b through 110b with acf.ErrEVTReserved without presenting the byte_msg_payload at the interface, reject a non-zero evt[2:0] with no byte_msg_payload with acf.ErrEVTMissingPayload per TC18 §12.9.1, and treat evt[2:0] = 111b as a TC18 §12.7.1 configuration access into the endpoint's EP_func block that is not presented at the interface.

requirements.title: Config.Validate enforces baud rate, data bits, parity, and stop bits when enabled
requirements.text: uart.Config.Validate shall return nil for a disabled endpoint regardless of its other fields, and for an enabled endpoint shall return ErrZeroBaudRate, ErrInvalidDataBits, ErrInvalidParity, or ErrInvalidStopBits as appropriate for an implausible field.

requirements.title: Parity.Valid and StopBits.Valid recognize exactly their defined values
requirements.text: uart.Parity.Valid shall return true for exactly ParityNone through ParitySpace and false otherwise; uart.StopBits.Valid shall return true for exactly StopBitsOne through StopBitsTwo and false otherwise.

requirements.title: UART Config encoders/decoders round-trip and never panic
requirements.text: uart.EncodeConfig/DecodeConfig shall round-trip a Config value and shall return ErrShortBuffer or ErrTrailingBytes rather than panicking on a malformed buffer.

requirements.title: HandleRequest routes Write to TX and Read to RX, rejecting neither flag or a non-payload-less read
requirements.text: uart.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall dispatch a request with FlagWrite set to TX and a request with FlagRead set to RX, shall return ErrRequestMustReadOrWrite for a request with neither flag set, and shall return ErrReadRequestNotPayloadLess for a read request carrying a nonempty body.

requirements.title: HandleRequest rejects the wrong endpoint, an ungranted stream, or a disabled endpoint
requirements.text: uart.Endpoint.HandleRequest shall return ErrWrongEndpoint when a request's ByteBusID does not match the endpoint's own address, the underlying server.ErrAccessDenied when the requesting stream has no access grant, and ErrUARTNotConfigured when the endpoint's Config.Enabled is false.

requirements.title: TX uses the configured Transport, defaults to TX-to-RX loopback, and queues a TX-complete trigger
requirements.text: uart.Endpoint shall transmit through its configured Transport when one is set via SetTransport, shall default to looping transmitted bytes directly into its own RX FIFO when none is set, and shall queue a TriggerTXComplete event carrying the accepted byte count for every TX write.

requirements.title: RX read drains the FIFO up to the requested count and reports partial delivery on underfill
